title: Representative island arena steady state

measurement.semantics: Include exactly the declared contiguous measurement frame range; the count is pending capture qualification.
measurement.missing_reason: Measurement frame count has not been selected.

image.description: Pinned arena image checkpoint after readiness.
image.missing_reason: A clean light-v2 diagnostic image is archived, but no pinned parity reference or visibility qualification is defined.

visibility.description: Expected visible section identities at the arena checkpoint.
visibility.missing_reason: A diagnostic image is archived, but visible section identity has not been independently checked.

known_limitations: Draft only; no V1 performance score or player count is asserted.
The existing dense terrain capture is not a V1 substitute.
The light-v2 diagnostic image is not a pinned parity reference and visibility qualification remains open.
Replay uses ordinary wall-clock timing, so nondeterminism remains and scoring is not eligible.
